title: SpecialistOutput
description: Structured output required from a claude-seo specialist invoked by scripts/route_to_specialist.py, answering ONE specific question about ONE suspected opportunity -- never a general audit. Any new_facts entry without evidence is rejected during ingestion (scripts/route_to_specialist.py: ingest) and can never enter the dossier.

hypothesis.description: The exact question this specialist was asked to answer

commercial_mechanism.description: The acquisition mechanism, not a generic SEO statement -- e.g. 'competitors have a dedicated page for X search intent, this business does not' -- never 'this hurts SEO' / 'this could improve rankings'

evidence.description: Required -- an unsupported new_facts entry is rejected wholesale during ingestion, never silently dropped-but-kept

new_facts.description: Any NEW factual claim beyond what was in the specialist's input context -- each requires its own evidence or it cannot enter the dossier
